The '''Gravane system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Klina sector/Legends|Klina sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. [[Gravane station]] was situated in the system, and it was the site of some fighting during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
